definitions.explanation: The act of canceling or revoking something, such as a reservation, order, license, or statement.

examples.japanese: {予約|よやく}の{取消|とりけし}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'd like to cancel my reservation.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}の{取消|とりけし}は{発送|はっそう}{前|まえ}までです。
examples.english: Order cancellation is only possible before shipping.

examples.japanese: {免許|めんきょ}の{取消|とりけし}{処分|しょぶん}を{受|う}けた。

notes:
FORMATION:
{取|と}り (taking) + {消|け}し (erasing)

VERB FORM:
・{取|と}り{消|け}す (to cancel)

WRITING:
Also written as {取り消し|とりけし} with okurigana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{取消|とりけし}{料|りょう} (cancellation fee)
・{取消|とりけし}{手続|てつづ}き (cancellation procedure)
・{免許|めんきょ}{取消|とりけし} (license revocation)
・{予約|よやく}{取消|とりけし} (reservation cancellation)

RELATED:
・キャンセル (cancel - loanword, more casual)
